To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we were able to identify high-frequency Urdu complex predications, that the use of bigrams was a useful technique for this purpose, and that we were also able to identify combinations of nouns and verbs we had not been previously aware of.

(1) bigram extraction from a large Urdu corpus can be a useful tool for identifying complex predications, (2) visual analytics can be useful for the analysis of bigram data, and (3) the results of the bigram analysis are not without their limitations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the distributional patterns of nouns in Urdu N+V complex predications.

the question of how much of the combinatorial possibilities of complex predications can be identified by means of a simple extraction of bigrams, and whether the results of this extraction are useful for NLP applications.
the identification and classification of Urdu complex predications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of bigram analysis is a promising avenue of investigation for the identification of N+V complex predications.
the extraction of bigrams is a promising avenue for the identification of N-V complex predicational patterns.

the extraction of bigram information is a promising approach, but that it needs to be supplemented with other methods, such as the manual identification of complex predications and the use of existing language-particular lexical and grammatical resources.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of bigrams can indeed be a useful tool for the extraction of complex predicates in a language with a high degree of productivity.
we were indeed able identify a number of high frequency complex predications and that we also were able to identify some low frequency combinations.
the extraction of bigrams from a “raw” corpus is a promising approach for identifying high frequency N-V combinations in a language like Urdu/Hindi.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the extraction of fine-grained distributional information from a large corpus of Urdu can be a useful first step towards the development of a robust and reliable parser for Urdu complex predications.
bigram extraction can be a useful tool for identifying complex predications.
bigram extraction can be a useful tool for identifying Urdu N-V complex predicational patterns.
